say:1:1630154501:1.text: It's Meowris! She's rallied so many cats into her nonsense!
say:1:1630154501:1.source_cn: 是喵丽丝——她竟然煽动了那么多猫咪陪她胡闹！
say:1:1630154501:1.male: It's Meowris! She's rallied so many cats into her nonsense!
say:1:1630154501:1.female: It's Meowris! She's rallied so many cats into her nonsense!

say:2:1630154502:1.text: "Overthrow the humans," "burn the system down" Ridiculous!
